# Kids Mile High Pediatric Dentistry

> Comprehensive pediatric dental care in the Denver metro area with board-certified specialists offering advanced treatments for children, teens, and special needs patients.

Kids Mile High Pediatric Dentistry operates multiple locations across Denver, Englewood, and Thornton, Colorado, providing specialized dental care for infants through teens. The practice features board-certified pediatric dentists and orthodontists using advanced technologies like WaterLase lasers, Isolite systems, and Myobrace for comfortable, effective treatment.

## Dental Services & Treatments

- [Dental Treatments for Kids](https://www.kidsmilehigh.com/dental-treatments-for-kids): Pediatric dental treatments and services for kids in Denver and Englewood.
- [Dental Treatments for Teens](https://www.kidsmilehigh.com/dental-treatments-for-teens): Dental treatments for teens including sealants, orthodontics, and Invisalign in Denver.
- [Special Needs Dental Care](https://www.kidsmilehigh.com/special-needs-patients): Specialized dental care for special needs patients with compassionate techniques and sedation.

## Advanced Technology & Treatments

- [WaterLase Laser Dentistry](https://www.kidsmilehigh.com/waterlase-laser): Information about WaterLase laser technology for pain-free pediatric dental procedures.
- [Isolite System](https://www.kidsmilehigh.com/isolite): Information about Isolite System technology for comfortable dental procedures without jaw pain.
- [Myobrace System](https://www.kidsmilehigh.com/myobrace): Guide to Myobrace System for natural teeth straightening without traditional metal braces.
- [Under Armour Performance Mouthguards](https://www.kidsmilehigh.com/mouthguards): Custom Under Armour Performance Mouthguards for sports protection and athletic safety.
